about.intro: I'm Adrián Escribano Pérez, Full Stack developer specialized in React, Next.js, Node.js and TypeScript.
about.introFull: I'm Adrián Escribano Pérez, a Full Stack developer with over 3 years of experience building modern, scalable and intuitive web applications.
about.storyP1: My journey in software development started with curiosity and ended in obsession. From my first lines of HTML to complete architectures with Node.js and PostgreSQL, each project has taught me that good software is the one that disappears: the user only sees a seamless experience.
about.storyP2: I firmly believe in combining robust backend engineering with a frontend that delights. It's not enough for it to work: it has to feel right.
about.storyP3: I'm currently expanding my foundations at 42 Madrid, where peer learning and C/C++ projects give me a deeper perspective on how software actually works at a low level.
about.title: Developer passionate about creating exceptional experiences

about.tl2024Desc: Complete web platform development in a professional environment. Spring Boot, Java and scalable architectures.
about.tl2025Desc: Joined the 42 Madrid cursus to deepen systems, algorithms and C/C++.

ruta-opencode.title: OpenCode Path
ruta-opencode.description: Master OpenCode from start to finish: installation, models, MCP, Skills, parallel agents, RAG, AI frameworks and editor plugins.

ruta-java.title: Java Path
ruta-java.description: Learn Java from scratch to advanced: syntax, OOP, collections, Streams, Spring Boot and REST APIs. Complete path for enterprise backend developers.

ruta-frontend.title: Frontend Web Path
ruta-frontend.description: From zero to modern frontend: HTML and CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js and testing. Complete path to master web development from fundamentals to production.

ruta-c.title: C Path
ruta-c.description: Learn C from scratch: variables, pointers, manual memory management, structs and systems programming. Ideal for understanding how a computer really works.

ruta-cpp.title: C++ Path
ruta-cpp.description: Master modern C++: OOP, STL, smart pointers, move semantics and high-performance programming. Builds on the C foundations.

ruta-backend-js.title: JavaScript Backend Path
ruta-backend-js.description: Build professional REST APIs with Node.js and Express, connect PostgreSQL databases and deploy a complete backend with Supabase. The modern counterpart to the Java path.

ruta-databases.title: Databases Path
ruta-databases.description: Master data: what databases are, relational SQL and NoSQL, and work with MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Supabase to choose the right technology for each project.

ruta-python-ia.title: Python & AI Path
ruta-python-ia.description: Learn Python and become an AI engineer: create assisted projects, choose agent frameworks, launch parallel agents and build assistants with RAG.

ruta-fullstack.title: Full-Stack Path
ruta-fullstack.description: Unify frontend and backend in a single app: React, Next.js, API with Node and Express, database with Supabase and end-to-end testing. The path that joins Web and Backend branches.

ruta-angular.title: Angular Path
ruta-angular.description: From TypeScript to enterprise Angular applications: standalone components, directives, services, HttpClient and routing. The Angular path building on frontend fundamentals.

ruta-vue.title: Vue Path
ruta-vue.description: JavaScript to Vue 3: Composition API, reactivity, directives, props and emits, Vue Router and Pinia. The progressive framework building on frontend fundamentals.

ruta-css-diseno.title: CSS & Design Path
ruta-css-diseno.description: Turn CSS into a professional design tool: fundamentals, animations, modern layouts with container queries and Tailwind CSS building on frontend fundamentals.

ruta-javascript-moderno.title: Modern JavaScript Path
ruta-javascript-moderno.description: Deep dive into JavaScript: solid fundamentals then async, fetch, ES modules and modern browser APIs. The bridge between beginner and senior.

ruta-typescript-avanzado.title: Advanced TypeScript Path
ruta-typescript-avanzado.description: Go beyond basic types: generics, utility types, narrowing, discriminated unions and professional React typing with strict tsconfig.

ruta-apps-interactivas.title: Interactive Apps Path
ruta-apps-interactivas.description: Turn your apps into products: global state with Zustand, data fetching with React Query, Next.js in production, performance with Core Web Vitals and WCAG accessibility.

ruta-go.title: Go Path
ruta-go.description: Learn Go from scratch: syntax, functions, structs, interfaces, goroutines and an HTTP server. A modern and fast language for high-performance backend.

ruta-rust.title: Rust Path
ruta-rust.description: Build on C foundations to master Rust: ownership, structs, enums, traits and errors. Safe memory and maximum performance in systems.

ruta-nestjs.title: NestJS Path
ruta-nestjs.description: Structure your backend with NestJS: modules, controllers, services, DTOs with validation, TypeORM, JWT guards and Swagger. Building on TypeScript and Express foundations.

ruta-devops.title: DevOps Path
ruta-devops.description: Automate the complete application lifecycle: Git, Docker, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, monitoring and observability with Prometheus/Grafana, and infrastructure as code with Terraform.
